title: The hypergraph–QLR cone equality conjecture
statement: For each $n$, let the $n$-party hypergraph cone be the cone of entropy vectors obtained from $n$-party hypergraphs, and let the $n$-party QLR cone be the cone defined by the quantum linear rank inequalities. **Hypergraph–QLR cone conjecture.** The $n$-party hypergraph and QLR cones coincide for all $n$. The cones are known to coincide through four parties, and the paper gives contraction-map evidence for five parties; equality in general would identify the hypergraph cone with a cone of quantum-compatible entropy vectors.
source_name: Ning Bao, Newton Cheng, Sergio Hernández-Cuenca and Vincent P. Su, “The Quantum Entropy Cone of Hypergraphs”, arXiv:2002.05317 (2020).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.05317

Status: **open** according to the source (as of February 2020). “An open question in quantum Shannon theory is whether the stabilizer and QLR cones are the same for more than $4$ parties.”
